Speech Delivered at Pro-Palestine Protest in front of The New York Times 5/28 #PalestinianJustice #DisabilityJustice 

All systems of oppression are intertwined. Justice and freedom for Palestine is inextricably linked to justice and freedom for all. 🇵🇸 

Tired of shouting into the void? If you’re local, DM us to show up. 🗣️ Follow @alhelou.y2 for the truth on the ground in Gaza. 📲
